description: Dairy site (cream treatment, butter oil, cleaning in place) whose streams run in batches within a daily cycle, loads in kW with start and end times. Analysed on its time-averaged streams (storage at any temperature) and, for operation, slice by slice with a heat pump between hot and cold storage loops.

provenance.data source: Stampfli, Atkins, Olsen, Walmsley, Wellig (2019), Energy 182, 236-253, Table 1 (CC BY); companion paper Stampfli et al. (2018), CET 70, 1789-1794.
provenance.stream data: published (Table 1, with start and end times); wash water heating uses CP x dT (242.9 kW) instead of the printed 260.25 kW (scripts/validation/reproduce_stampfli2019.py)
provenance.eta_lorenz: published: zeta = 0.35, the Carnot fraction of Sec. 2.3 (isothermal condenser and evaporator, so Lorenz = Carnot)
provenance.source_T_C: reproduced: T*ev = 7.93 °C from Eq. 9 (pinch.time_slices.storage_heat_pump) at the paper's T*co,sel = 33.8 °C
provenance.dT_cont_K: published: real temperatures = shifted +/- 1.25 dTmin = 12.5 K (Eqs 5-6, two loop exchangers and the refrigerant)
provenance.basis: none: operating days per year are not published; the hourly operation is reported per year of prices, every day running the published daily schedule
provenance.ambient_T_C: assumed: 15 °C, as the other secondary cases
provenance.economics: prices only (see economics.sources); capacity factors of the dispatch are illustrative (1, 1.5, 2 x the design rate) and their extra investment is not counted

economics.skipped: no annual basis in the case file

cop_ranges.note: COP of each heat pump on four bases: the case's Lorenz efficiency; manufacturer-data fits (Jesper et al. 2021) at lift = sink outlet - source inlet, with their standard deviation; a glide-matched blend (+16 %, Brendel et al. 2024) for sink glides of 25 K or more; the Lorenz model with the efficiencies achieved by IEA HPT Annex 58 closed-cycle demonstration plants (min, median, max). The fits come from small-glide machines, so for a large sink glide they are a pessimistic bound. fit_in_range = False: the point is outside the data behind the fit.

designs.basis: market products, supplier operating points (median) (not computed: HP with storage loops: no supplier product has published points covering this unit)

time_slices.note: Time Slice Model (direct heat recovery only) and Time Average Model (storage at any temperature) per cycle; heat pump with hot and cold storage loops after Stampfli et al. (2019); hourly operation against the year's hourly prices (pinch.time_slices.annual_dispatch).

operation.limits: COP constant at part load; extra capacity's investment not counted; days with a clock change left out
